en_title: ‘It Represents an Evolution of the First-Person Shooter’ — Why Infinity Ward Is Giving Extraction Shooters Another Shot in Modern Warfare 4’s DMZ Mode
cn_title: 《现代战争4》为何再试撤离射击
subtitle: 「第一人称射击的进化」
opus_summary: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》以DMZ模式再试撤离射击。团队吸取前作成长感不足的教训，加入基地升级与等级系统，并借助停战、通缉等机制，让玩家自行选择合作或交战。

paragraphs.en: The last time Call of Duty attempted an extraction shooter, we were living in a world without Arc Raiders in it. The DMZ beta that came with 2022’s Modern Warfare 2 was a valiant first draft, but one that ultimately failed to hook a sizable player base with its shoot, loot, and extract loop. Now the genre’s outlook is seemingly very different, with a boom in player interest thanks to the initial success of Embark Studios’ sci-fi shooter at the back end of 2025. With its popularity not quite where it was some months ago, the jury remains out on whether extraction shooters will ever be able to topple the battle royale anytime soon, if ever. But Infinity Ward is willing to try to find that out for itself with Modern Warfare 4 and its DMZ mode — the studio’s second shot at such an idea.
paragraphs.cn: 《使命召唤》上一次尝试撤离射击玩法时，《ARC Raiders》还没有问世。2022年《使命召唤：现代战争2》附带的DMZ测试版是一次勇敢的初步尝试，但它终究没能靠射击、搜刮、撤离的玩法循环吸引到足够多的玩家。如今，这一类型的前景似乎已大不相同。Embark Studios旗下的科幻射击游戏在2025年末取得初步成功，带动玩家对撤离射击的兴趣激增。不过，如今它的热度已不及几个月前，撤离射击能否在短期内取代大逃杀，甚至究竟有没有可能做到，仍无定论。但Infinity Ward愿意通过《使命召唤：现代战争4》及其DMZ模式亲自寻找答案——这是这家工作室第二次尝试这种玩法。

paragraphs.en: IGN spoke to Joe Cecot, Modern Warfare 4’s multiplayer creative director, to learn all about why Call of Duty is returning to the extraction shooter, and what was learned from its MW2 beta.
paragraphs.cn: IGN采访了《使命召唤：现代战争4》多人模式创意总监Joe Cecot，了解《使命召唤》为何重返撤离射击，以及团队从《现代战争2》的测试版中吸取了哪些经验。

paragraphs.en: “The group of people that work on DMZ love DMZ, and they loved [the MW2 version]” reveals Cecot. “Even though the beta was very hard to make, we were very proud and happy with what we made, and we learned a lot.”
paragraphs.cn: 「开发DMZ的这群人热爱DMZ，也很喜欢［《现代战争2》的版本］，」Cecot透露，「虽然测试版的开发过程非常艰难，但我们对做出来的成果非常自豪，也很满意，而且学到了很多。」

paragraphs.en: “We've worked on it for three plus years now,” he continues. “From the moment we finished live support, we moved into the next DMZ, the next big map with Hajin. And we knew we wanted to continue that. For a lot of us, this is our favorite kind of genre. It's that kind of tension.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们开发它已经有三年多了，」他继续说道，「结束后续运营支持后，我们就立即转向了下一部DMZ，开始制作下一张大型地图Hajin。我们很清楚，自己想继续做下去。对我们很多人来说，这是我们最喜欢的游戏类型。我们喜欢的就是那种紧张感。」

paragraphs.en: “I think the other thing is there aren't too many genres that really you can have PvE, you can have PvP, you can have looting, you can have narrative, you can have completionists, you can have significant player progression, you have persistence, you have this amazing sense of player growth. I can have fun rescuing people. I can have fun working together. I can have fun going and just hunting people.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我觉得还有一点是，很少有游戏类型能同时容纳这么多东西：PvE、PvP、搜刮、叙事，能满足全收集玩家，能提供丰富的玩家成长内容，还能保留游玩进度，让玩家获得绝妙的成长感。我可以从救人中获得乐趣，也可以享受合作，或者干脆去猎杀其他玩家，同样能玩得开心。」

paragraphs.en: Working together is something Call of Duty players aren’t often asked to do. Deathmatch and the constant search for the next kill have been at the core of its online experience for two decades now. Sure, you’ll act as a team when squadding up in multiplayer, or trying to be the last group standing in Warzone, but rarely are you asked to work together as a coherent unit to achieve your goal – it’s more often a dozen individuals working in tandem. Other extraction shooters like Arc Raiders have managed to foster a community and code of conduct from the ground up, almost building whole new languages through emotes and interactions in how to talk to strangers. Call of Duty players simply haven’t fostered anything like this over the years, in part because its multiplayer modes haven’t historically offered the tools to allow such behaviour. So when it comes to DMZ, how does Infinity Ward intend to rewire players who instinctively pull the trigger the moment they see another person?
paragraphs.cn: 《使命召唤》很少要求玩家通力合作。二十年来，死亡竞赛和不断寻找下一个击杀目标，一直是其线上体验的核心。当然，无论是在多人模式中组队，还是在《使命召唤：战争地带》中争取成为最后存活的小队，玩家都会以团队形式行动。但游戏很少要求大家作为配合默契的整体共同达成目标——更多时候，只是十几名玩家各自作战、同时推进。《ARC Raiders》等其他撤离射击游戏则成功从零开始，培育出社群及其行为准则。玩家通过表情动作和互动与陌生人交流，几乎创造出了一套全新的语言。多年来，《使命召唤》玩家并没有形成类似的交流方式，部分原因在于，其多人模式过去并未提供支持这类行为的工具。那么，面对那些一见到其他人就本能地扣下扳机的玩家，Infinity Ward打算如何在DMZ中改变他们的习惯？

paragraphs.en: “We think these kinds of games are very helpful when they do have that PVP. And I think it's that tension of not restricting behavior that makes it so interesting,” Cecot explains. “We saw cooperation in the original DMZ. We saw people communicate. We saw people work together. I experienced it myself. We have assimilation, which lets you merge with someone else and get onto the same squad. We have a truce flag in the pinwheel that you throw down, and it basically tells everyone in the area that an operator near you is requesting a truce. Ping it to acknowledge, and if you ping it, you both get a flag above your head when you look at each other. So you know we have a truce now, but it's non-binding. If you shoot them, they can shoot you. We have yes, no, and friendly pings as well that are global that you can do to each other if you're not on voice chat to say friendly, friendly.
paragraphs.cn: Cecot解释道：「我们认为，有PVP对这类游戏很有帮助。我觉得，正是这种不限制玩家行为所带来的紧张感，让游戏如此有趣。我们在最初的DMZ中见过玩家合作，见过他们交流，见过他们并肩行动。我自己也经历过。游戏里有合队功能，让你能与其他玩家合并队伍，加入同一支小队。轮盘菜单里还有停战旗，你可以把它扔在地上，基本上就是告诉区域内的所有人：附近有一名干员请求停战。标记旗帜就能表示同意，之后你们看向彼此时，双方头顶都会显示一面旗帜。这样你就知道，双方现在已经停战了，但这并没有强制约束力。如果你向对方开枪，对方也可以向你还击。我们还有表示同意、拒绝和友好的通用标记，即使不用语音聊天，你们也能互相发送，用来表达友好。」

paragraphs.en: “An order will never ask you to kill a player. And so though players can choose to hunt each other, we're careful to make sure that just killing a player isn't really valuable outside of the loop that's on them. Now, if you kill a player who has a bounty on their head because they've been killing other players, we have the new wanted system that, well, if you're wanted, people can pay for your intel to locate you and hunt you. Then we're kind of building an ecosystem where the killers can hunt each other, and the other players can kind of avoid them. So we're trying to walk that line of creating this sandbox, but I think there will be PVP, but I think there's a bunch of players that will have fun just communicating, talking to each other, and making friends.”
paragraphs.cn: 「任务指令绝不会要求你击杀玩家。因此，虽然玩家可以选择互相猎杀，但我们会谨慎把关，确保除了拿走对方身上的战利品，单纯击杀玩家并没有多少价值。至于那些因为不断击杀其他玩家而遭到悬赏的玩家，我们加入了新的通缉系统：如果你被通缉，其他人就能付费购买你的情报，找到你并追杀你。这样，我们就构建出了一种生态，让热衷杀戮的玩家互相猎杀，其他玩家则可以尽量避开他们。我们想在打造这个沙盒的同时把握好分寸。我认为游戏里会有PVP，但也会有很多玩家只是通过交流、聊天和交朋友，就能获得乐趣。」

paragraphs.en: Cecot’s passion for the extraction shooter is clear to see, as he hopes for its continued growth as the big new multiplayer genre. Call of Duty successfully managed to jump on the battle royale bandwagon with Warzone, which hit on a formula following the series’ initial misfire with Blackout. Infinity Ward will be hoping that trend continues with MW4’s DMZ mode, succeeding where MW2’s previous beta stumbled four years ago.
paragraphs.cn: Cecot对撤离射击游戏的热情显而易见，他希望这一多人游戏新兴大类能继续发展壮大。《使命召唤》最初凭借Blackout模式尝试大逃杀时未能成功，后来则通过《使命召唤：战区》找到了合适的玩法，成功赶上了大逃杀的热潮。Infinity Ward希望《现代战争4》的DMZ模式能延续这一趋势，在四年前《现代战争2》测试版受挫的地方取得成功。

paragraphs.en: When Arc Raiders launched last year, it instantly became the first true extraction shooter smash hit, with almost 1 million concurrent players across all platforms at its peak. Cult classics such as Escape from Tarkov and Hunt: Showdown paved the way, but Arc Raiders felt like a real breakthrough moment for the genre. Since then, though, player numbers have shrunk considerably for Arc Raiders. Meanwhile, Bungie’s Marathon has proven that even a best-in-class entry into the genre can struggle, with few logging into the game to witness its quality. Despite this, Cecot sees a bright future for the genre, and DMZ’s place within it.
paragraphs.cn: 《ARC Raiders》去年一经推出，就成为撤离射击品类首款真正意义上的爆款，巅峰时全平台同时在线玩家接近100万。《逃离塔科夫》和《猎杀：对决》等拥有忠实拥趸的经典作品为这一品类铺平了道路，但《ARC Raiders》似乎才是这个品类真正取得突破的标志。不过，此后《ARC Raiders》的玩家人数已大幅缩水。与此同时，Bungie的《失落星船：马拉松》也证明，即便是品类中的顶尖作品，也可能举步维艰，鲜有玩家登录游戏，亲自体验它的品质。尽管如此，Cecot仍然看好这一品类的未来，也看好DMZ在其中的前景。

paragraphs.en: “So to me, DMZ and the extraction shooter represents an evolution of the first-person shooter,” he says. “When I think about classic Quake, my first love, to Modern Warfare and Halo and the 5v5 or the 6v6, into the evolution into Battlefield and the big war into Battle Royale. After that, for me, it's like the extraction shooter is taking the MMO plus the Minecraft plus the first-person shooter, PVP, and we'll put it all on this big melting pot, and then we'll let players go find their own fun. So to me, it represents kind of an evolution of how players play video games as well.”
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「在我看来，DMZ和撤离射击游戏代表了第一人称射击游戏的一次进化。回想起来，从我的最爱、经典的《雷神之锤》，到《现代战争》和《光环》，再到5对5或6对6的对战，随后发展成《战地风云》那样的大规模战争，再到大逃杀。在这之后，我觉得撤离射击就像是把MMO、《我的世界》、第一人称射击和PVP全都放进一个大熔炉，再让玩家自己去寻找乐趣。所以在我看来，它也代表着玩家玩电子游戏的方式发生了某种进化。」

paragraphs.en: So, what has Infinity Ward learned from its first swing at the genre three years ago? It was by no means a disastrous attempt, with plenty of fun to be found, but it just never managed to capture the size of audience needed to become something more than the beta it launched as. It’s something Cecot and the team are looking to address this time around, with their biggest lesson learned centering on player progression and keeping them coming back for more.
paragraphs.cn: 那么，Infinity Ward从三年前对这一品类的首次尝试中学到了什么？那次尝试绝非灾难，游戏里有不少乐趣，但它始终没能吸引到足够多的玩家，无法摆脱推出时的测试版状态。这一次，Cecot和团队希望解决这个问题，而他们吸取的最重要教训，就在于玩家成长，以及如何让玩家不断回到游戏中。

paragraphs.en: “We knew making the original DMZ that player growth was core to extraction shooters,” says Cecot. “The original DMZ created a very fun sandbox with very low friction for entry. Your weapon was on a cooldown, your loadout was just like the rest, you could just equip. Loot was very available. And so it was very approachable, but it was that lack of player growth that I think made it less sticky.
paragraphs.cn: Cecot说：「制作最初的DMZ时，我们就知道玩家成长是撤离射击游戏的核心。最初的DMZ打造了一个非常有趣的沙盒，入门门槛也很低。武器有冷却时间，配装和其他模式一样，直接装备就行。战利品也很容易获取。所以这个模式很容易上手，但我认为，正是因为缺乏玩家成长，它才不那么能留住玩家。

paragraphs.en: “We had a lot of players come in and stay. They loved the sandbox. They love mastering the sandbox. They love the social aspect of it. They love that they could do whatever they wanted. But I think player growth is the thing that we knew we needed to hit really hard in this DMZ. And that's where upgrading your FOB came from. That's where the DMZ rank came from, where no matter what you do, you're earning XP, which is progressing your rank. So we're valuing your time. I think that's probably the biggest learning.”
paragraphs.cn: 「很多玩家加入后留了下来。他们喜欢这个沙盒，喜欢钻研并掌握其中的玩法，喜欢它的社交元素，也喜欢能随心所欲地做自己想做的事。不过，我们知道，这次的DMZ必须重点做好玩家成长。前沿作战基地（FOB）升级功能就是由此而来的，DMZ等级也是如此。无论做什么，玩家都能获得经验值，提升等级。这样，玩家投入的时间就有了价值。我想，这大概是我们学到的最重要的一点。」

paragraphs.en: Only time will tell if DMZ can have the same impact on the extraction shooter space as Warzone did on battle royale. Included as part of Modern Warfare 4, rather than as its own game or free-to-play service, it’s available to play now.
paragraphs.cn: DMZ能否像《使命召唤：战区》影响大逃杀游戏那样，在撤离射击领域产生同样的影响，只有时间能给出答案。该模式现已开放游玩，作为《使命召唤：现代战争4》的一部分推出，而非独立游戏或免费运营的游戏。

paragraphs.en: For more of Modern Warfare 4, check out our review of the campaign and whether Infinity Ward considers this to be the end of the reboot series .
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多《使命召唤：现代战争4》的内容，可以阅读我们的战役评测，以及Infinity Ward是否将本作视为重启系列终章的相关报道。
